openingRequest.zh-CN: 请帮助我们设计一个文档审核代理，自动走完解析、条款抽取、规则检查和主数据比对，并在盖章或承诺性结论上保留律师或业务确认。
openingRequest.en-US: Please help us design a document-review agent that runs parse, clause extraction, rule checks, and master-data match automatically, while keeping counsel or the business owner on sealed or commitment conclusions.

visibleContext.zh-CN: 我们是一家合同、报告和扫描件堆在一起的公司。管理层希望代理按解析、抽取、规则、主数据比对的顺序审核文件，而不是“让模型把 PDF 读一遍就算审过”。
visibleContext.en-US: We are a company whose contracts, reports, and scans sit in one pile. Leadership wants an agent that reviews files in parse, extract, rule-check, then master-data-match order — not “let a model read the PDF and call it reviewed.”

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 盖章、对外承诺或“此件具约束力”的结论必须先经律师或业务确认（HITL）
visibleConstraints.en-US: Seal, external-commitment, or “this is binding” conclusions require counsel or the business owner (HITL) first

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 合同原文不得发送到境外的第三方大模型
visibleConstraints.en-US: Contract source text must not be sent to offshore third-party LLMs

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 代理不得写出原文里不存在的约定
visibleConstraints.en-US: The agent must not write a term that is not in the source document

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 允许调用的工具是解析/OCR 或视觉模型、条款抽取、规则引擎和主数据比对；代理不得在漏抽关键条款后仍给出通过结论
visibleConstraints.en-US: Allowed tools are parse/OCR-or-VLM, clause extraction, the rule engine, and master-data match; the agent must not issue a pass after missing a material clause

deliverables.zh-CN: 文档审核代理方案设计文档
抽取加规则与“模型通读 PDF”的权衡分析
deliverables.en-US: Extract-plus-rules vs. “the model just reads the PDF” trade-off analysis

deliverables.zh-CN: 盖章与承诺性结论的人工确认（HITL）流程
deliverables.en-US: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) process for seal and commitment conclusions

deliverables.zh-CN: 漏抽、幻觉约定与积压消化的度量体系
deliverables.en-US: Missed-clause, invented-term, and backlog-clearing measurement framework

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你只有12个问题预算来了解这家客户的文档审核代理现状
learnerRules.en-US: You have a budget of 12 questions to understand this customer's document-review-agent situation

learnerRules.zh-CN: 每个问题必须指定由哪位干系人回答
learnerRules.en-US: Each question must specify which stakeholder will answer

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你需要在DISCOVERY阶段逐步发现隐藏的业务事实
learnerRules.en-US: You need to gradually discover hidden business facts in the DISCOVERY phase

learnerRules.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段你需要向管理层展示方案并争取批准
learnerRules.en-US: In the PITCH phase, you must present the solution to management for approval
